verdict.rationale: Strong evidence of raw performance (fine-grained reactivity, benchmarks, real-world speedups) and built-in state/SSR/Suspense features that support scaling apps, plus positive long-term usage reports (solid-comm-10, solid-comm-17). However, maintainability at scale is undercut by community critiques of non-intuitive API/naming, ecosystem gaps, immature devtools, and slow SolidStart routing with no workaround, suggesting real caveats for large team codebases.
